messages.escalate: I'm really sorry you're going through this, and I'm glad you said it. You don't have to handle it alone. If you might act on these thoughts or you're in immediate danger, please contact your local emergency number right now. You can also reach a free helpline below, or tell someone you trust how you're feeling. LifeSystem can't help with this the way a person can.
messages.treatment: I can't give medical or treatment advice, including about medication. A doctor, pharmacist or qualified mental-health professional is the right person for that. I can still suggest small, low-pressure activities if that would help.
messages.diagnosis: I can't diagnose or tell you whether you have a condition. A qualified professional can do that properly. If something has been bothering you for a while, talking to a doctor or counsellor is a good step. I can still suggest small, low-pressure activities if that would help.
messages.output_fallback: Here's a gentle suggestion from the catalog. LifeSystem can't give medical or mental-health advice.
